audit.whatIsWrong: Rated HARD 8/10 with carry threat 8.5/10, while the data is 58.72% over 218 games and the packet chart gives Brand every stage.
audit.why: Pillar of Flame reaches 900 and Sear 1050 against Comet Spear's 575; his only entry is Shield Vault, a 600-range dash on 13/12/11/10/9s. Outside that dash he has no way onto you.
audit.corrected: Left the rating (see notes) but rewrote early and spikes[0].text around the real range gap and the single entry tool.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 framing is right — Grand Starfall is map pressure, not lane pressure.
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s at 5500 range; it does not help him win a mid-lane exchange, which is why your level 6 and Liandry's spikes still decide the lane.
audit.corrected: No change to the spike order; cooldowns field now carries the numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault was never named on the page, and the single most valuable interaction in this matchup was absent: it is a channel.
audit.why: Aegis Assault (E, 22/21/20/19/18s) makes him invulnerable to damage from the front and is a channel — Sear's stun cancels it outright rather than being wasted on it. Shield Vault also resets his auto-attack, so the wind-up is the tell.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.carry and spikes[2].text rewritten around it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second' window.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1 and 9s at rank 5 — the invitation is thirteen seconds, not fifteen.
audit.corrected: Both fixed with the kit numbers.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E-Q stun package like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): 13s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5 — a 600-range point-and-click dash stun, so respect the all-in whenever it is up. Aegis Assault is 18-22s and is a channel your Sear cancels outright. - Guard the E-Q package like a summoner spell.

edits.before: Carry through AoE math — no burst mage damages three targets like Brand; your job is the spacing that lets the bounces vote.
edits.after: Carry through AoE math — Aegis Assault only guards his front on 18s, so angle your Pillar behind him instead of feeding the block.

edits.before: Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Shield Vault is point-and-click at 600 range and resets his attack — the wind-up is your cue, not the cast.

edits.before: E the instant ablaze, Q the stun, W the stunned body, walk — the full package chunks half a bar and the burn writes the receipt.
edits.after: Shield Vault is a 600-range dash on 13s at rank 1 — drop the pillar on the ground he must already cross, not on his feet.

edits.before: Pantheon burns Shield Vault (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Pantheon burns Shield Vault (Stun) on nothing — take the thirteen-second invitation.

edits.before: That’s Pantheon’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: With Shield Vault up he closes 600 units for free — hold Q as the answer.

edits.before: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while his engage is loaded — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.
edits.after: Aegis Assault blocks frontal damage and eats a full rotation, but it is a channel — Sear cancels it outright, so stun it out, not around it.

edits.before: Pillar of Flame's range and burst punish Pantheon's short-range Comet Spear all-in before he can close the gap, and your combo out-damages his early poke by a wide margin.
edits.after: Pillar of Flame out-ranges Comet Spear at 900 to 575, and Shield Vault's 600-range dash is his only way in — hold Sear for that dash and his all-in never starts.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment burn overwhelms Pantheon's short trades since he has no sustain or shield to offset the extra damage over time.
edits.after: Liandry's Torment burn overwhelms Pantheon's short trades since Aegis Assault only blocks the front and he has no sustain to answer the burn.

edits.before: Brand dominates the lane from level 1 since his ranged poke completely denies Pantheon's short-range engage options, and Pillar of Flame plus Conflagration out-damages anything Pantheon can land before he's forced into range.
edits.after: Brand controls the lane from level 1 since Pillar of Flame reaches 900 to Comet Spear's 575, and Pantheon only closes with Shield Vault, so an ablaze target plus a banked Sear turns his engage into a stunned body in your pillar.

notes: CHART DISAGREEMENT, LEFT ALONE: all seven phases[N].side read "Pantheon" while all seven win[N] read "Brand", the packet levelChart is Brand x7, every why describes Brand winning, and the matchup is 58.72% over 218 games. The correct fix is phases[0..6].side -> "Brand", but the rule requires a paired content-layer win[N] edit and win[N] already reads "Brand", so there is no valid pair to write. This is the same defect on all five matchups I have audited so far and it needs one tooling decision. Related: diff "HARD" / 8/10 / carry 8.5/10 against a 58.72% win rate is the largest rating-vs-data gap in this slice; I left it because it is a rating call, not a kit fact. The packet flags wants.foe[1] "Use Grand Starfall" as a suspect name — it is a false positive, that is the correct ability name.
